<mxfile host="Electron" agent="parameter-golf" version="21.0.0"> <diagram id="workflow-multi-agent" name="Workflow"> <mxGraphModel dx="1000" dy="600" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1000" pageHeight="500" background="#ffffff" math="1" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" />
<mxCell id="orchestrator" value="<b>Master Orchestrator</b><br>Thesis framing, Reverse outline, Task dispatch, Final fusion" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="360" y="30" width="280" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="analyst" value="<b>Empirical Analyst Agent</b><br>59 runs data extraction, 6-move sequence, Pareto frontiers" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="60" y="160" width="260" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="theorist" value="<b>Theoretical Investigator Agent</b><br>Module triads, LoRA+ dynamics, 6 vetoed directions analysis" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="370" y="160" width="260" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="designer" value="<b>Visual &amp; Drawio Designer Agent</b><br>Draw.io XML architectures, Python 300DPI publication charts" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="680" y="160" width="260" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="gatekeeper" value="<b>Mechanical &amp; Style Gatekeeper Agent</b><br>M1-M18 mechanical gates, S1-S31 semantic gates, Zero em-dashes, Sino-English natural integration" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="250" y="300" width="500" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="deliverable" value="<b>FINAL_REPORT.md</b><br>Publication-ready ICLR/CVPR standard report &amp; runbook" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#2ca02c;strokeWidth=3;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="360" y="410" width="280" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Edges linking multi-agent workflow --> <mxCell id="e_orch_analyst" value="Task Contract &amp; Metrics" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;fontSize=10;" edge="1" parent="1" source="orchestrator" target="analyst"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_orch_theorist" value="Deductive Hypotheses" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;fontSize=10;" edge="1" parent="1" source="orchestrator" target="theorist"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_orch_designer" value="Visual Specifications" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;fontSize=10;" edge="1" parent="1" source="orchestrator" target="designer"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_analyst_gatekeeper" value="Empirical Drafts &amp; Tables" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#666666;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;fontSize=10;" edge="1" parent="1" source="analyst" target="gatekeeper"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_theorist_gatekeeper" value="Theory &amp; Veto Proofs" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#666666;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;fontSize=10;" edge="1" parent="1" source="theorist" target="gatekeeper"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_designer_gatekeeper" value="Charts &amp; Vector Diagrams" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#666666;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;fontSize=10;" edge="1" parent="1" source="designer" target="gatekeeper"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_gatekeeper_deliverable" value="M1-M18 Gate Passed" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;strokeColor=#2ca02c;strokeWidth=2.5;endArrow=classic;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="gatekeeper" target="deliverable"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
